profile.headline: Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase
profile.summary:
Languages: Python, Kotlin, TypeScript
Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Django, Git, Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ IDEA, CircleCi, Slack, Terraform, AWS Cloud Development Kit
Technologies: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, AWS (DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch, API Gateway, S3), MySQL, OpenAPI

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Operated and supported AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms within a lean DevOps team, supporting development and research workloads
• Led DevOps enablement sessions and maintained deployment tooling and documentation to support developer self-service
• Owned Argo CD and Helm-based deployment pipelines for assigned services, ensuring stable releases
• Took ownership of complex infrastructure and deployment issues, unblocking teams

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Migrated Ads Creator insights to AWS lambda with Timestream, eliminating timeouts and reducing p99/p90 latency to 3.97s/2.45s.
• Rebuilt Stripe integration by replacing a production-only internal service, enabling test-mode support and enhancing frontend and QA testing with simulated payment methods, allowing for more efcient and comprehensive testing in development and staging environments.
• Built and managed CloudWatch dashboards and alerts using CDK and Terraform, automating monitoring setups and alerting the team via Slack and PagerDuty when error rates or latencies exceeded predefned thresholds.
• Built integration test suites and automated QA-stage API testing via CircleCI, strengthening deployment confdence and reducing manual validation across two services

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained code spanning from endpoint to database interaction, to support Eventbrite's pricing model, which generated $9.29m in revenue in 2nd half of 2023, exceeding the set goal by 54.8%
• Resolved a customer-impacting bug by updating code to prevent recurrence, adding unit tests for verifcation, and developing a shell script to correct event data for 35k events
• Identifed and fxed retry logic for failed DAX requests caused by missing event data in the database, resulting in a 96.7% decrease in service alert messages
• Updated legacy service code to facilitate simultaneous calls to both legacy and new services for validating the new service's endpoint responses, resulting in a 99.6% accuracy rate

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Consultant @ Mindtree, Azure Active Directory
•	Responsible for managing core allocation requests to meet service demands
•	Created queries to monitor and report status of core allocation requests to identify and resolve issues
•	Reduced mitigation time of high core usage incidents by 30%

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked to replace legacy feature and integrate with web application used by basketball operations
•	Collaborated with engineer lead on system design to improve data processing and management
•	Built out REST API and XML processor to improve data filtering capacity

positions.title: Research Assistant @ Boeing Advanced Research Center
positions.description:
•	Worked with Boeing product development to engineer new bracket design that utilizes material and mechanical innovations
•	Performed mechanical analysis of different bracket designs using ANSYS and ABAQUS
•	Modeled multiple bracket designs through SolidWorks and rapid prototyping through 3D printing
Experience in Printing: ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene) and PEEK (Polyether ether ketone)

Programming Languages:
•	MatLab: FEM calculations
•	Python: Abaqus Macros for parameterization + G-code manipulation

positions.title: Package Engineer
positions.description:
•	Oversaw piping specialty items and made sure all equipment had been purchased correctly in order to prevent delays during construction
•	Reviewed and approved engineered drawings and test reports to confirm all valves were manufactured to client’s specifications 
•	Managed time-sensitive task of reviewing purchased valves for fugitive emission compliance

positions.title: Piping Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed stress analysis on piping systems per ASME code to maximize safety and operational performance
•	Collaborated with multiple disciplines to ensure piping systems met all design requirements

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Performed root cause analysis, isolating key variables based on operational data and on-site observation 
•	Designed and executed multiple experiments on stress relief process, bringing rework rate down from 25.8% to 9.4% 
•	Created technical report consisting of detailed explanations of the manufacturing process 
•	Facilitated onsite training to implement standard work method, saving $10,000 a year in operational costs

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description:
•	Conducted interviews across multiple disciplines to identify redundant processes in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software 
•	Created analysis report which proposed a solution that decreased the number of input fields by 56%

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

testScores.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering (PE) Exam - Mechanical: Machine Design and Materials
